issue.summary: GrassBladeFieldDetail renderers are parented below Ground, but grass_blade_field_contract.json was absent from ground_domain.contractPaths. The renderer-domain coverage check therefore had a generic Ground scope while the detailed grass manufacture/material specification was omitted from the construction/material source bundle sealed to future render evidence.
issue.reasonForPriority: A visually strong grass render must not be scoreable if its detailed physical metadata is not bound to the same capture. This is a fail-closed evidence-admissibility issue, not a source-side Visual Fidelity point gain.
